name: Polly
source:
Polly is a high-school student with a very foul mood. She is constantly angry and sullen. She has purple dyed hair, multiple piercings and a large tattoo on her calf.

Her mother died giving birth to her and her father blames her for loosing his wife and verbally abuses her. As a consequence, she is acting out, skipping school, engaging in petty theft, and other rebellious actions. She hides her hurt feelings behind her sullen exterior, never letting anyone close. The only one to have some friendship with her seems to be Isabella.

The protagonist catches her shoplifting in Betty's boutique, makes her put it back and. then gives her a spanking in one of the changing rooms. When she mentions that she is a bad person, he corrects her by saying that she is not a bad person, she did a bad thing, and there is a big difference between them. Polly then says that her father always says that she is a bad person. The protagonist tries to get her to open up a little and manages to get a few smiles before she catches herself and storms out.

Polly is part of the gymnastics team trained by Svetlana, together with Isabella, Mila, and Sophia. Svetlana also tutors her in dance in the dancing studio. Naturally, Polly claims to hate both of these activities but she still continues doing them and is quite good at them.
